description: Source code implementing data structures and functions for parsing and handling MIME magic files, including reading magic headers and lines, managing match lists, and reading from files.

classes.name: XdgMimeMagic
classes.description: Main data structure holding list of MIME magic matches and maximum extent.

classes.name: XdgMimeMagicMatch
classes.description: Represents a MIME type match with associated matchlets and priority.

classes.name: XdgMimeMagicMatchlet
classes.description: Represents a specific match condition within a MIME magic rule, including value, mask, offset, and range.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_magic_matchlet_new
methods.description: Creates a new XdgMimeMagicMatchlet instance with default values.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_magic_matchlet_free
methods.description: Frees a linked list of XdgMimeMagicMatchlet instances.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_magic_match_free
methods.description: Frees a linked list of XdgMimeMagicMatch instances.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_magic_read_to_newline
methods.description: Reads data from a file until newline or null character, returns null-terminated string.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_magic_read_a_number
methods.description: Reads a number from a file, returns -1 on failure.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_magic_parse_header
methods.description: Parses a magic header line, extracting priority and MIME type.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_magic_parse_error
methods.description: Skips lines until newline, indicating a parse error.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_magic_parse_magic_line
methods.description: Parses a magic line, creating matchlets based on file content.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_magic_insert_match
methods.description: Inserts a match into the MIME magic list based on priority.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_magic_new
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new XdgMimeMagic structure.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_magic_free
methods.description: Frees an XdgMimeMagic structure and its contents.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_update_mime_magic_extents
methods.description: Updates the maximum extent of data to check based on matchlets.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_magic_matchlet_mirror
methods.description: Reverses the order of matchlets in a list.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_magic_read_magic_file
methods.description: Reads and parses a magic file, populating the XdgMimeMagic structure.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_magic_read_from_file
methods.description: Reads a magic file from disk and initializes the MIME magic structure.
